column5: He took the initiative to carry my luggage for me.
column6: 主动 is acting on one's own, without being asked: 主动帮助 (to offer help on one's own), 很主动 (very proactive), 主动学习 (to study of one's own accord).

column5: This idea is very subjective.
column6: 主观 is based on one's own feelings, not on facts: 很主观 (very subjective), 主观想法 (a subjective idea), 主观看法 (a subjective view).

column5: The owner of the house is not at home.
column6: 主人 is the owner or the host: 房子的主人 (the owner of a house), 小狗的主人 (a dog's owner), 做主人 (to be the host).

column5: Our director is very busy today.
column6: 主任 is the head of a department or an office: 办公室主任 (the head of an office), 班主任 (a class teacher), 一位主任 (a director).

column5: Rice is our staple food.
column6: 主食 is the main food of a meal: 吃主食 (to eat the staple food), 早饭的主食 (the staple of breakfast), 米饭 (rice) and 面条 (noodles) are common staples.

column4: 今天的主题是保护环境。
column5: Today's theme is protecting the environment.
column6: 主题 is the main theme: 活动主题 (the theme of an event), 主题很清楚 (the theme is clear), 主题公园 (a theme park).

column4: 会议的主席是一位老教授。
column5: The chair of the meeting is an old professor.
column6: 主席 is the person who chairs a meeting or leads a group: 会议主席 (the chair of a meeting), 一位主席 (a chairperson).

column5: Have you registered an account?
column6: 注册 is to register officially: 注册账号 (to register an account), 注册公司 (to register a company), 请先注册 (please register first).

column5: Housing here is very expensive.
column6: 住房 is housing, as a thing to live in: 住房很贵 (housing is expensive), 住房问题 (the housing problem), 住房条件 (housing conditions).

column5: When travelling, accommodation is more expensive than food.
column6: 住宿 is a place to stay, or to stay somewhere: 住宿费 (the cost of accommodation), 提供住宿 (to provide accommodation), 在学校住宿 (to board at school).

column5: Please write down your address.
column6: 住址 is the place where one lives: 家庭住址 (a home address), 新住址 (a new address), 写住址 (to write an address).

column3: to pay attention to; to stress
column5: This company pays great attention to quality.
column6: 注重 is to treat something as important: 注重质量 (to stress quality), 注重学习 (to focus on study), 注重细节 (to attend to detail).

column5: He grabbed my hand.
column6: 抓 is to grab or to catch: 抓住 (to grab hold of), 抓鱼 (to catch fish), 抓紧 (to hold tight).

column3: to make the most of; to hurry up
column5: There is not much time left; please hurry up.
column6: 抓紧 is to not waste time: 抓紧时间 (to make the most of time), 抓紧学习 (to hurry up and study), 抓紧一点 (to hurry up a little).

column5: He is an expert in Chinese.
column6: 专家 is an expert: 一位专家 (an expert), 请专家 (to invite an expert), 专家说 (experts say).

column5: In class, one must listen attentively.
column6: 专心 is to be focused on one thing: 专心学习 (to study with full attention), 很专心 (very focused), 不专心 (not focused).

column5: His ideas have changed.
column6: 转变 is a change in thinking or in a situation: 转变想法 (to change one's ideas), 转变态度 (to change one's attitude), 一个转变 (a change).

column5: Please pass this news on to him.
column6: 转告 is to pass on a message to someone: 转告消息 (to pass on news), 请转告 (please pass the word on), 转告给 (to pass on to).

column5: They decorate the room with flowers.
column6: 装饰 is to decorate, or a decoration: 装饰房间 (to decorate a room), 墙上的装饰 (decorations on the wall), 用花装饰 (to decorate with flowers).

column4: 他们的新房子正在装修。
column5: Their new house is undergoing renovation.
column6: 装修 is to do up a house or a shop: 装修房子 (to renovate a house), 在装修 (being renovated), 装修费 (renovation costs).

column5: His car crashed into a tree.
column6: 撞 is to hit or bump into something: 撞到 (to bump into), 撞车 (a car crash), 被撞 (to be hit).

column5: His physical condition is very good.
column6: 状况 is how things stand: 身体状况 (physical condition), 经济状况 (the financial situation), 学习状况 (how one is getting on in study).

column5: He is not in good form today.
column6: 状态 is the state someone or something is in: 好状态 (good form), 学习状态 (one's state of study), 工作状态 (one's state at work).

column5: My elder brother is chasing me from behind.
column6: 追 is to chase: 追人 (to chase someone), 追上 (to catch up with), 追梦 (to chase a dream).

column4: 他一直追求自己的梦想。
column5: He has always pursued his dream.
column6: 追求 is to pursue a goal or an ideal: 追求梦想 (to pursue a dream), 追求目标 (to pursue a goal), 追求幸福 (to pursue happiness).

column5: He is not qualified to take part in the competition.
column6: 资格 is the right or the qualification to do something: 有资格 (to be qualified), 没有资格 (not qualified), 资格考试 (a qualification exam).

column4: 这个项目需要很多资金。
column5: This project needs a lot of funds.
column6: 资金 is a sum of money for a purpose: 需要资金 (to need funds), 没有资金 (no funds), 资金不足 (a shortage of funds).

column5: His posture looks very good.
column6: 姿势 is the way one holds the body: 坐的姿势 (the way of sitting), 站的姿势 (a standing posture), 好的姿势 (a good posture).

column3: to consult; to ask for advice
column4: 我想咨询一下这个问题。
column5: I want to ask for advice on this problem.
column6: 咨询 is to ask an expert for advice: 咨询医生 (to consult a doctor), 电话咨询 (consulting by phone), 咨询一下 (to ask about it).

column5: We must protect resources.
column6: 资源 is something useful that a place has: 水资源 (water resources), 自然资源 (natural resources), 学习资源 (study resources).

column5: Her skirt is purple.
column6: 紫 is purple: 紫的 (purple), 紫花 (a purple flower), 紫葡萄 (purple grapes).

column5: His children are all abroad.
column6: 子女 are sons and daughters, in a formal way: 他的子女 (his children), 教育子女 (to educate one's children), 两个子女 (two children).

column4: 自从来到这里，他每天都很忙。
column5: Since coming here, he has been busy every day.
column6: 自从 is "since" a point in the past: 自从…以后 (ever since …), 自从去年 (since last year), 自从那天 (since that day).

column5: This door will open automatically.
column6: 自动 is automatic, by itself: 自动打开 (to open automatically), 自动门 (an automatic door), 自动关机 (to switch off automatically).

column4: 他很自觉，每天自己做作业。
column5: He is very conscientious and does his homework by himself every day.
column6: 自觉 is doing the right thing without being told: 很自觉 (very conscientious), 自觉学习 (to study of one's own accord), 自觉遵守 (to follow of one's own accord).

column5: Please write out this letter.
column6: 字母 is a letter of an alphabet: 拼音字母 (pinyin letters), 大写字母 (a capital letter), 小写字母 (a lower-case letter).

column4: 我们要先提高自身的水平。
column5: We must first improve our own level.
column6: 自身 is "oneself, one's own": 自身的问题 (one's own problems), 自身条件 (one's own conditions), 他自身 (he himself).

column5: I am very free at weekends.
column6: 自由 is free, or freedom: 很自由 (very free), 有自由 (to have freedom), 自由时间 (free time).

column4: 老师综合大家的意见，做了决定。
column5: The teacher combined everyone's opinions and made a decision.
column6: 综合 is to bring things together, or comprehensive: 综合意见 (to combine opinions), 综合考虑 (to consider as a whole), 综合能力 (overall ability).

column4: 这家公司的总部在上海。
column5: This company's headquarters is in Shanghai.
column6: 总部 is the headquarters: 公司总部 (company headquarters), 总部在… (the headquarters is in …), 在总部工作 (to work at headquarters).

column5: There are ten of us altogether.
column6: 总共 is "altogether": 总共多少钱 (how much altogether), 总共十个 (ten in all). It is like 一共.

column5: The total number of students is fifty.
column6: 总数 is the total number: 学生总数 (the total number of students), 总数是… (the total is …), 总数不多 (the total is not large).

column4: 总体来说，这个计划很好。
column5: On the whole, this plan is good.
column6: 总体 is the whole: 总体来说 (on the whole), 总体情况 (the overall situation), 总体上 (as a whole).

column5: When he grows up, he wants to be president.
column6: 总统 is the president of a country: 当总统 (to be president), 总统先生 (Mr President), 美国总统 (the American president).

column5: In short, we must study hard.
column6: 总之 is "in short", and it starts a closing sentence: 总之，… (in short, …), 总之就是… (in a word, it is …).

column5: The rent of this house is very high.
column6: 租金 is the money paid to rent something: 付租金 (to pay rent), 租金很贵 (the rent is expensive), 每月租金 (monthly rent).

column5: Office workers are busy every day.
column6: 族 is a suffix for a group of people who share something: 上班族 (office workers), 打工族 (part-time workers). It is also in 民族 (an ethnic group) and 家族 (a clan).

column5: I have enough money to buy this book.
column6: 足够 is "enough": 足够的钱 (enough money), 足够用 (enough to use), 足够多 (plenty).

column3: to form; to make up (parts come together)
column5: This team is made up of ten people.
column6: 组成 is to make up a whole from parts: 由…组成 (to be made up of …), 组成一个队 (to form a team), 组成小组 (to form a group).

column4: 这两种颜色的组合很好看。
column5: The combination of these two colours looks very nice.
column6: 组合 is to put together, or a combination: 颜色的组合 (a combination of colours), 组合在一起 (to put together), 新组合 (a new combination).

column4: 妈妈阻止了孩子玩手机。
column5: Mum stopped the child from playing with the phone.
column6: 阻止 is to stop someone from doing something: 阻止孩子 (to stop a child), 阻止事情发生 (to stop something happening), 阻止他 (to stop him).

column5: The school is organising the students to go on a visit.
column6: 组织 is to organise, or an organisation: 组织活动 (to organise an activity), 一个组织 (an organisation), 国际组织 (an international organisation).

column5: The child's mouth is very small.
column6: 嘴巴 is a casual, spoken word for the mouth: 张大嘴巴 (to open the mouth wide). 嘴 is the usual word and is used in more phrases: 嘴里 (in the mouth).

column5: He drank a lot of alcohol and got drunk.
column6: 醉 is to be drunk: 喝醉 (to get drunk), 醉了 (drunk).

column5: At first, I could not speak Chinese.
column6: 最初 is the very beginning: 最初的想法 (the first idea), 最初几天 (the first few days), 最初的时候 (at the beginning).

column5: He is this year's best student.
column6: 最佳 is "the best": 最佳时间 (the best time), 最佳办法 (the best method), 最佳选择 (the best choice).

column5: We must respect our teachers.
column6: 尊敬 is to respect: 尊敬老人 (to respect the elderly), 受人尊敬 (to be respected), 尊敬的先生 (Dear Sir).

column4: 大家都要遵守交通规则。
column5: Everyone must obey the traffic rules.
column6: 遵守 is to follow a rule: 遵守规定 (to abide by rules), 遵守时间 (to keep to time), 遵守法律 (to obey the law).

column4: 他作出了一个重要的决定。
column5: He made an important decision.
column6: 作出 is to make or to put forward, in formal use: 作出决定 (to make a decision), 作出回答 (to give an answer), 作出努力 (to make an effort).
